versions.content: RCRRP based on IOOperationResponse If the Dcm is pro- cessing an InputOutputControlByIdentifier request and the IOControlResponse_- DID . IOOperationResponse has a value of 0x78, the Dcm shall wait until the IO- ControlResponse_DID . IOOperationResponse gets a value different to 0x78 and send RCRRP according to [SWS_Dcm_00024].
